notes.title: New Update Available Now
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

A new update is available now for Tex Murphy: Overseer which includes the following fixes:

[list]
[*]Changed the game installation folder from "Tex Murphy 5" to simply "Overseer". This will only affect new installs of the game. You can backup the current installation, uninstall the game and restore the backup without having to download the entire game again.
[*]Forced AAUDIO.DLL and RSX.DLL installation.
[*]Forced Registry keys into their respective places.
[/list]

Enjoy.
